# The appointments Samantabhadra made — and who is keeping them

One myth is a story. A cycle of myths is a specification. Read Samantabhadra's cycle in order and the industries fall out of it one by one.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Samantabhadra
- **Pantheon:** Buddhist
- **Domain of influence:** Universal Good, Practice
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Society & Spirit · Health & Wellbeing
- **Strongest seat:** Faith & Spiritual Organizations
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 417 of 542

## The Cycle, Read Forward

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations — through *Origins*

Samantabhadra appears in buddhist tradition as universal good, practice.  The name's meaning, "'Universal Beneficence' — the Bodhisattva of practice, rider of the white elephant", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Primary seat: Samantabhadra embodies universal good, practice — the core of faith.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. Industries do not invent their archetypes; they inherit them and call them best practice.

### Mental Health & Emotional Wellness — through *Worship and Memory*

Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Samantabhadra in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Resonant seat: Samantabhadra shares symbolic territory with mental health.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. The trade thinks it is optimizing a process. It is re-enacting a charter.

## The Theme That Runs the Cycle

The stories of Samantabhadra place universal good, practice at the center of a living mythological world.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

The atlas is not a horoscope. Seats are earned from the sources — argued, weighted, published — and every one of them can be challenged at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). A match that cannot survive an argument does not survive review. That is the whole trick: the patterns are claims, and claims can be tested.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in faith & spiritual organizations, mental health & emotional wellness, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/samantabhadra/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
